plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Web Developer A.S. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 22, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7833/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local. IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY NOTE: the map's published 'Total Units: 73-75' is inconsistent with its own semester grids, which sum to 59-61 (verified row by row: Sem 1 3+1+3+3+3+3=16; Sem 2 2+4+2+1+3+3+1=16; Sem 3 2+2+3+1+2+3=13 at lower bound; Sem 4 1+3+4+3+3=14; all four semester headers match their rows). The sibling CalGETC version of this degree (map 7999, published one day later) is internally consistent at 62 units, confirming the program's scale is ~60 units, not 73-75. The published total appears to be a stale/copy-paste error. Lower bound 59 encoded from the verifiable semester sums (Sem 3 Area L7B 2-3 -> 2; Sem 3 elective 3-4 -> 3). The map's GE AREA cell for 'Local Area 2-Math & Quantitative Reasoning' reads 'Cal-GETC Area 2' (apparent typo in a Local GE map); encoded as CRC Area L2. List A (minimum 5 units): CISC 324, CISW 308, CISW 310, CISW 355, CISW 402, CISP 350 — satisfied in-map by CISC 324 (1) + CISW 308 (2) + CISW 402 (2) = 5 units, each footnoted 'Suggested from List A'. CISP 350 prerequisite per map: CISA 320 & 3 units of any programming language. Elective suggestions (units needed to total 60; refer to Course Number): Sem 1 — CISP 300 Algorithm Design/Problem Solving (3 units; advisory MATH 335; meets Certificate in CIS-Web Programming); Sem 2 (1 unit) — CISA 320 Intro to Database Management (1 unit; advisory CISC 302 or 310; meets Certificate in CIS-Web Programming); Sem 3 (3-4 units) — CISP 360 Intro to Structured Programming (4 units; prerequisite CISP 300 or MATH 400) or BUS 100 English for the Professional (3 units; advisory BUSTEC 302 & 303); Sem 3 Area L3 — ART 301 Digital Drawing & Composition or ARTNM 324 Digital Design (advisory ART 300, 320, CISC 302, JOUR 330). With the suggested electives, this map meets the requirements for the Certificate of Proficiency in CIS-Web Publishing and the Certificate of Achievement in CIS-Web Programming (no separate sequences published). Advisories (recommended, not required, per map legend): CISW 300 advisory CISC 305; CISW 440 advisory CISA 320 or CISP 350; CISP 353 advisory CISP 352; CISW 308 advisory CISW 304; CISW 402 advisory CISW 410; CISW 350 advisory CISC 306 & CISW 300; CISW 321 advisory CISC 305; CISW 410 advisory CISP 300 or CISW 310. Local Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
